title: One time Tasks, Bug
body:
Using the app for a very long time its really amazing but Would be great if also one time tasks could be in this app as well instead of other apps. It’s a little inconvenient to add habit and then remove it just for that one time in here. But if beside habit we could have one time tasks section it would be amazing . 

The bug is that a lot of times if you change goal value of a habit it shows the old one still on future days even though registers the new goal value. 

Thanks
author: Dooky McOwl
